items.rationale: Removal and transport of affected household contents (rug) is covered as handling necessary for cleaning or replacement (7.1.7(h)), provided the rug was physically affected by the water. No exclusion applies.

items.description: High-quality LED lighting above billiard table
items.rationale: No evidence the lighting was physically damaged by the insured event; replacement of undamaged or upgraded accessories is not covered (7.1.5, 7.1.9).
Cleaning of water-affected household contents is covered if it restores the item (7.1.10). The rug was soaked by the event.

items.description: Electrical inspection of robot vacuum cleaner
items.rationale: Inspection to determine damage to an affected item is covered (7.1.7(i)), but the robot vacuum's damage is not indemnified as it is the device that spread the water further and was operated while the policyholder was present (7.1.11, 3.3(i)).
Damage to the device that enlarged the affected area is excluded (3.3(i), 7.1.11); the policyholder saw it running and did not intervene.
Disassembly is covered if necessary to inspect or repair water-affected property (7.1.7(a), 7.1.7(h)), and the table was affected.

items.description: Inspect billiard table for moisture damage
items.rationale: Inspection of affected property to determine restoration needs is covered (7.1.7(i)).

Restoration of affected household contents is covered, but the billiard table is subject to the EUR 500 sub-limit for large-format leisure furniture (4.8.1(a)). All costs for the table (cloth, cues, light, handling) are aggregated and capped at EUR 500.
Replacement of accessories for the billiard table is included in the EUR 500 sub-limit for the table (4.8.2).
Reassembly after repair/inspection is included in the EUR 500 sub-limit for the table (4.8.3).
Repair of water-damaged ceiling is covered as repair of affected building component (7.1.5, 7.1.7(a)). Reference: similar ceiling repairs in cases 61/70.

items.description: Fill ceiling and wall surfaces 15 m²
items.rationale: Filling and making good affected surfaces is covered as part of repair (7.1.5, 7.1.7(a)).
Final cleaning after repair is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference cases 63/66, price prior per pc about 208.
Drying equipment for affected areas is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference cases 63/66, price prior for 3 pcs about 234.
Moisture measurement to monitor drying is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference cases 63/66, about 233 per measurement.
Final moisture measurement to confirm drying is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference cases 63/66, about 233 per measurement.

items.description: Remove floor covering in guest WC 5 m²
items.rationale: Removal of water-damaged floor covering in affected room is covered (7.1.7(a)); reference case 61.
Removal of water-damaged skirting in affected areas is covered (7.1.7(a)); reference cases 36/59, about 8 per m.
Drying of insulation layer in affected floor is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference case 27.
Rental of drying equipment for affected areas is covered (7.1.7(b)); price prior for 2 pcs about 123.
Compressor for drying insulation is covered as necessary drying equipment (7.1.7(b)); reference case 27.

items.description: Remove damaged parquet in drip zone below stairwell (migration path) 6 m²
items.rationale: Removal of water-damaged parquet in the migration path is covered (7.1.5, 7.1.7(a)); reference case 61.

items.description: Renew parquet floor in drip zone below stairwell (migration path) 6 m²
items.rationale: Renewal of water-damaged parquet in affected area is covered (7.1.5, 7.1.7(c)); reference case 61.

items.description: Remove and renew additional parquet area spread by robot vacuum
items.rationale: The additional area affected only by the robot vacuum is excluded unless the policyholder could not reasonably have prevented the enlargement (7.1.11). Here, the policyholder was present and did not intervene, so this area is not indemnified.

items.description: Supply and install new skirting boards 12 m
items.rationale: Replacement of skirting in affected areas is covered (7.1.7(c)); reference cases 36/59, about 32 per m.
Opening up ceiling to access and repair water damage is covered (7.1.7(a)); reference case 61.
Leak detection to locate the source is covered (7.1.7(e)); reference cases 65/66, about 700 per call-out.
Moisture measurement to establish extent of damage is covered (7.1.7(b)); reference cases 63/66, about 233 per measurement.
Inspection and disassembly to access and repair the source of the leak is covered (7.1.7(e)).

items.description: Replace fill valve in toilet cistern
items.rationale: Replacement of defective part from which water escaped is covered at standard-grade cost (7.1.7(e)).
Labour for covered repair work is indemnified at customary rates (7.1.7(g)); price prior for 3 hrs about 226.
One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)); price prior about 84.
